  • LoRA Service

    LLM fine-tuningLlama 3 8B · 4-bit QLoRA

    A REST service that fine-tunes Llama 3 8B on one speaker's messages so it writes in that speaker's voice.

    train.py · config.py

    "r": 8,
    "lora_alpha": 16,

    "task_type": "CAUSAL_LM",
}

    — LoRA fine-tuning service, code on GitHub

  • Price Assistant

    LLM + XGBoostParse · predict · explain

    An LLM turns a free-text listing into features, XGBoost predicts the price, the LLM explains the estimate.

    1. query"3 bed, 2 bath in Austin, 1800 sqft"
    2. gemini · parse{ bedrooms: 3, bathrooms: 2, city: "Austin", sqft: 1800 }
    3. xgboost · predictprice estimate from the trained pipeline
    4. gemini · explainplain-language reasons behind the estimate
    — Real estate price assistant, code on GitHub

  • CLIP Search

    EmbeddingsCLIP vs ResNet-18

    Text-to-image and image-to-image search, comparing CLIP with ResNet-18 features and two distance metrics.

    — Image search with CLIP, code on GitHub
